## Featured Case Studies & Production Systems

- **Igoo (https://igoo.uz)** — Multi-tenant cloud CRM and ERP platform for learning centers (built at Infonex, 2026). Engineered seamless cross-subdomain authentication token handoff from `igoo.uz` to tenant subdomains without repeat logins, alongside full API integration and core UI modules (`Next.js`, `React 19`, `TypeScript`, `TanStack Query`, `Tailwind CSS`).
- **HomeX Admin** — Operations and management platform (built at Infonex, 2026). Engineered frontend UI architecture and granular checkbox-based Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) with strict route and navigation guards (`React 19`, `TypeScript`, `Tailwind CSS`, `TanStack Query`).
- **Tashkent Logistics** — Custom B2B logistics and accounting automation (client project, 2026). Conducted 2 days of on-site operational discovery inside the business and built a tailored Telegram bot automating order tracking, driver balances, and accounting (`Telegram Bot API`, `TypeScript`, `Node.js / Fastify`, `PostgreSQL`, `Next.js`).
- **HalalHub (https://wehalalhub.com)** — Food discovery platform (built at Infonex, 2026). Reduced initial load time and redundant API calls with Next.js + React Query caching, built lag-free Reels video scrolling, viewport-driven infinite scroll, and Google & Apple OAuth (`Next.js`, `TanStack Query`, `TypeScript`, `Tailwind CSS`).
- **AuraNews (https://github.com/omonboyweb/news-startup)** — Open-source AI news aggregation portal (creator, 2026). Automated web news ingestion and structured summarization via DeepSeek APIs and Google AI Studio (Gemini) paired with a fast Next.js interface (`Next.js 15`, `TypeScript`, `DeepSeek API`, `Google AI Studio`, `PostgreSQL`, `Tailwind CSS`).
